final_source_review.child_umask_validation: Strict int -1..0777; default -1 preserves inherited behavior elsewhere; production apply explicitly passes022 without mutating process-wide umask.
final_source_review.completion_candidate_only_calls: require_current_target=False is limited to pre-merge reviewed candidate checks/enqueue; final completion uses actual selected branch target.

findings.final_observation: Entry selection is captured in launch_pins and compared at every fence.
findings.original_issue: Mutable launch authority path/CID could be cleared after initial verification.

findings.final_observation: Full captured TLS lease identity, caller lease ID and durable currentness are checked inside mutation and before each replacement.
findings.original_issue: Writer checked the native lease only before entering the mutation boundary.

findings.final_observation: Each still-unwritten replacement compares current source bytes and mode with captured before image.
findings.original_issue: A later replacement could overwrite source drift after the initial context fence.

findings.final_observation: Both historical and current supplied targets are rejected after the selected branch changes a reviewed output. Candidate-only require_current_target=False is used in pre-merge enqueue/verification, not direct completion publication.
findings.original_issue: Helper verified only a supplied historical merged commit, even if current selected branch changed a reviewed output.

findings.final_observation: Private-index-derived intended byte/mode postimages are journaled before apply. Native successful apply uses bounded child umask022 and produces mode0644. Fault-injected approved byte/mode application with rc1 restores original bytes/mode0664. External byte drift is preserved and its native recovery lease retained; neither failed case captures reviewed effect or claims a write receipt.
findings.observation: Fault-injected git apply installs approved postimage and returns rc=1. Route is rejected with write_performed=false and no reviewed effect binding; baseline remains unrestored.
findings.recommended_boundary: Reconstruct intended patch postimages in the private Git index before mutation, register intended owned byte/mode effects before apply, and compare-and-swap rollback; preserve external drift.
